description: This file declares the SimpleSynchronousEntry class and related data structures for managing disk cache entries in a simple cache implementation, including file operations, reading/writing data, sparse data management, and entry lifecycle management.

classes.name: SimpleEntryStat
classes.description: Holds metadata about cache entry streams, including last used/modified times and data sizes, and computes file offsets.

classes.name: SimpleStreamPrefetchData
classes.description: Contains prefetch buffer and CRC for a cache stream.

classes.name: SimpleEntryCreationResults
classes.description: Results of creating or opening a cache entry, including pointers to the entry and file operations, and prefetch data.

classes.name: SimpleEntryCloseResults
classes.description: Holds estimated trailer prefetch size after closing an entry.

classes.name: SimpleSynchronousEntry
classes.description: Main class managing disk cache entries, including opening, creating, reading, writing, sparse data handling, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: SimpleSynchronousEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing a cache entry object.

methods.name: ~SimpleSynchronousEntry
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up cache entry resources.

methods.name: OpenEntry
methods.description: Opens an existing cache entry from disk.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry on disk.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens an existing or creates a new cache entry.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Renames the entry to prevent further access, effectively deleting it.

methods.name: DeleteEntryFiles
methods.description: Deletes all files associated with a cache entry.

methods.name: TruncateEntryFiles
methods.description: Truncates files of a cache entry, used after backend shutdown.

methods.name: DeleteEntrySetFiles
methods.description: Deletes multiple entries based on key hashes.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from a cache stream.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to a cache stream.

methods.name: CheckEOFRecord
methods.description: Checks the EOF record in a file for integrity.

methods.name: ReadSparseData
methods.description: Reads sparse data from the sparse data file.

methods.name: WriteSparseData
methods.description: Writes sparse data to the sparse data file.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Gets available data ranges in sparse data.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the cache entry, writing EOF records and updating prefetch info.

methods.name: GetFilenameForSubfile
methods.description: Returns filename for a subfile based on subfile type.
